headline: Ekko, Xayah and Kog'Maw lead patch 26.22
lede: More than half of the most-picked champions lose: 36 of the 65 picked in 5% or more of their role's games win less than half of them. Built on nine stat sites from Korea, Europe and North America, corrected for small samples and one-tricks.

takes.top: Singed is the outlier, with Kayle, Malphite and Shen behind him. In Diamond and up Kayle, Fiora and Singed lead and Malphite drops to A. Jayce and Yone are picked a lot and still lose, and Yasuo dropped more than anyone since last patch.
takes.jungle: Zyra, Lillia and Nunu lead. In high elo Nunu and Zyra are outliers, and Rek'Sai scores even higher but is picked in under 2% of Diamond+ games, too rarely to count as one. Lee Sin is in 13% of games and loses, and Qiyana is the worst popular pick in the role.
takes.mid: Ekko is the outlier at every rank, with Vex, Katarina and Vladimir behind him. Mel and Viktor gained the most since last patch, but Viktor is still a trap at 7.7% pick.
takes.adc: Kog'Maw and Xayah are ahead of everyone, and Corki gained more than any champion since last patch. Ezreal is in 15% of games and has the worst score of any popular ADC.
takes.support: Ten supports are S, so pick what fits your bot laner: Rell and Zilean score highest, and Rell is the outlier in high elo. Yuumi, Karma and Lux are popular and lose, and Thresh dropped the most since last patch.
